plugins.name: xiaoqi-pet
plugins.description: Xiaoqi desk pet: a native macOS companion plus a cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS) Electron companion that mirror live ZCode session activity (phases, tools, waiting states) via plugin hooks, with a multi-session task board, drawers, usage/balance capsule on the pet belly and notices.

description_i18n.zh-CN: macOS 原生 + Windows/Linux Electron 桌面小栖：实时展示 ZCode 多会话状态，任务看板、抽屉卡、通知、今日用量与套餐余量胶囊，还能让它说话。
